name: Zacchaeus
overview: The story of Zacchaeus, a wealthy chief tax collector in Jericho, reveals Jesus' intentional outreach to those marginalized by society. Despite his short stature, Zacchaeus eagerly sought to see Jesus by climbing a sycamore tree, demonstrating a sincere desire to encounter Him. Jesus' personal invitation to stay at Zacchaeus' house highlights His grace and willingness to engage with sinners, leading to a joyful reception and the beginning of transformation.
